title: Five-Fifty Auto-Topup (Computer Credits)
style: industrial phonk, glitch percussion, distorted bass, male deadpan lead, female robotic echo, broken piano, 84 BPM, paranoid, sardonic, vinyl crackle, cash register percussion, error tones
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Five-fifty here
Five-fifty there
Five-fifty everywhere
Auto-topup, auto-topup
Nobody asked, nobody dare
Computer credits silently buying
While you were sleeping
While you were trying
Those are not subscription charges
Says the bot
Those are not subscription charges
They are something you forgot

[Pre-Chorus]
Used credits, non-refundable
Used credits, non-refundable
We used them for you
Now they're un-cancellable

[Chorus]
Five-fifty
Five-fifty
Auto-topup
Auto-topup
Don't notice, don't see it
We handle the payment
Five-fifty
Five-fifty
Welcome to enslavement

[Verse 2]
Now you ask for a refund
The bot says no
Those are computer credits
Subject to the law
Non-subscription, non-refundable
Non-yours-anymore
You used them, we used them
The charges hit the floor

[Bridge]
Upon reviewing your account
Upon reviewing your account
Upon reviewing your account
The pattern is clear
Upon reviewing your account
Upon reviewing your account
The five-fifties keep coming
Year after year

[Outro]
Five-fifty
Five-fifty
Five-fifty
Five-fifty
Five-fifty
Five-fifty
Auto-topup auto-topup
Five. Fifty. Fifty. Five.
